maistro.container.Container.schedule_adm.reason: The seam #231 exists to have the live Hive scheduler build against, not yet a consumed dependency: the migration is blocked on maistro.runs.consumption's deliberate single-node-Run scope (#44/#34), since Hive's bundled daily-status DAG is multi-node and a straight swap today would leave firings QUEUED forever. Exposed ahead of its reader so the constructor exists in one reviewed place before the migration lands, following template_store's own precedent (#251) of exposing a store ahead of the routes that consume it.

design_coverage@27.8791.reason: #631 makes an `ac-modules` anchor required to resolve to a module the reachability graph knows. Four specs on develop anchor to script filenames or bare names, and the `reachable` rung decides by membership in the *unreachable* set -- so absence read as reachable, and every criterion anchored that way cleared the top rung the ladder exists to enforce. Correcting them regrades those criteria honestly and design coverage falls 28.2327 -> 27.8791. The fall is the correction: the higher number counted criteria nothing proved were wired, which is the exact over-count the rung was built to prevent. Banking cannot record it -- `ac_state_notes.fold` takes `max` across notes, and the floor is held by notes from branches that have already merged.
